title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Board
intro: [excited] Good evening, true believers, and welcome to Disney Jeopardy! Tonight we swing through New York, the multiverse and the parks with everyone's favorite wall-crawler. Hold on tight... [chuckles] this host is very sticky.

art.prompt: A nighttime city skyline seen from a water tower rooftop, glowing windows and a big full moon, a web strand stretching between buildings, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

categories.title: Spidey Basics
categories.intro: We begin with the web-head himself. [chuckles] If your senses are tingling, buzz in.

art.prompt: A cluttered teen bedroom desk with a camera, a science fair trophy and a jar of homemade goo, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Peter Parker gained his powers after a bite from this creature.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is a spider! One little bite, one big career change.

clues.clue: This kindhearted aunt raised Peter Parker in New York.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Aunt May! [warmly] The real hero of the family.

clues.clue: In the Marvel Cinematic Universe, Peter Parker grows up in this New York borough.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Queens! Home of the friendliest neighborhood in the multiverse.

clues.clue: In Spider-Man: Homecoming, Peter battles this winged villain who steals alien tech.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Vulture! [dramatically] Also, awkwardly, his prom date's dad.

clues.clue: In Spider-Man: No Way Home, Peter asks this sorcerer to make the world forget his secret identity.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Doctor Strange! A spell gone wrong, and the multiverse came knocking.

categories.title: Into the Spider-Verse
categories.intro: Now to the animated multiverse, where anyone can wear the mask. [excited] Leap of faith, everybody!

art.prompt: A colorful comic-style city street exploding with halftone dots, glitchy neon colors and swirling portals, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: In Into the Spider-Verse, this Brooklyn teen becomes a brand-new Spider-Man.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Miles Morales! Brooklyn's own, and what a leap of faith.

clues.clue: This spider-hero from a cartoon dimension is a pig named Peter Porker.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Spider-Ham! [laughs] That's all, folks.

clues.clue: Miles' cool Uncle Aaron is secretly this masked villain.
clues.reveal: [dramatically] The correct answer is the Prowler! Family dinners got complicated.

clues.clue: Into the Spider-Verse won the Academy Award in this category.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Best Animated Feature! A Spider-Man movie with an Oscar. Thwip!

clues.clue: In Across the Spider-Verse, Miguel O'Hara, leader of the Spider-Society, is the Spider-Man of this futuristic year.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 2099! [chuckles] Grumpy, futuristic, and very good at climbing.

categories.title: Friends and Foes
categories.intro: Picture category! Each image shows something tied to Spidey or one of his enemies. Tell me what or who it is.

art.prompt: A dark comic-book alleyway with dramatic shadows of strange figures cast on a brick wall, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Spider-Man shoots this from the devices on his wrists. What is it? Pictured: a close-up of a gloved wrist wearing a small metal gadget that shoots sticky white strands toward a lamppost.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is webs! Sticky, strong, and dissolves in about an hour. Very tidy.

media.prompt: A close-up of a gloved wrist wearing a small metal gadget that shoots sticky white strands toward a lamppost, original painterly illustration, no text, no logos, no people, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Which cackling villain zooms around on this? Pictured: a bat-winged green hover glider floating above a city street.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Green Goblin! [dramatically] Pumpkin bombs are not a Halloween treat.

media.prompt: A bat-winged green hover glider floating above a city street, with a satchel of small orange jack-o-lantern shaped bombs strapped to it, original painterly illustration, no text, no logos, no people, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Which master of illusion wears this? Pictured: a glass fishbowl dome helmet swirling with green smoke.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Mysterio! A fishbowl helmet and a lot of special effects.

media.prompt: A glass fishbowl dome helmet swirling with green smoke, resting on a purple cape on a theater stage, original painterly illustration, no text, no logos, no people, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Which brilliant villain uses these? Pictured: four long segmented metal mechanical tentacle arms with pincer claws attached to a harness.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Doctor Octopus! [chuckles] Four extra arms and still no hugs.

media.prompt: Four long segmented metal mechanical tentacle arms with pincer claws attached to a harness, in a dim laboratory, original painterly illustration, no text, no logos, no people, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Name the villain whose body is made of this. Pictured: a huge swirling tower of golden sand rising from a beach in the shape of a giant fist.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Sandman! [laughs] Chet still finds him in his shoes.

categories.title: Spidey at the Parks
categories.intro: To the parks, where the web-slinger flips, swings and recruits. [excited] Clap your hands for the stunts!

art.prompt: A rooftop of a sleek modern headquarters building at a theme park with a crowd watching from below, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Spider-Man flips high over the crowd in this land at Disney California Adventure.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Avengers Campus! Look up, he's on the roof again.

clues.clue: Spider-Man's web-slinging ride opened in 2022 at this European Disney resort.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Disneyland Paris! [excited] Ooh la la, Spider-Bots.

clues.clue: In WEB SLINGERS, runaway Spider-Bots were accidentally copied by this young genius's invention.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Peter Parker! He builds a helper bot, and it builds a few thousand friends.

clues.clue: Disney Imagineers built a robotic stunt double that flips through the air for Spider-Man. They call this tech this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Stuntronics! [excited] A robot doing backflips so the real Spidey can rest.

clues.clue: WEB, as in WEB SLINGERS, stands for this team of young inventors.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is the Worldwide Engineering Brigade! Bright young minds, slightly messy lab.

categories.title: Spidey Sayings
categories.intro: Our fan category: famous people, phrases and firsts from Spider-Man history. [chuckles] Excelsior.

art.prompt: A vintage newspaper printing press room with fresh pages flying, no readable text, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Complete the famous lesson: with great power comes great this.
clues.reveal: [warmly] The correct answer is responsibility! The words every Spider-Man lives by.

clues.clue: This loud newspaper boss always calls Spider-Man a menace.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is J. Jonah Jameson! [laughs] Get me pictures of Spider-Man!

clues.clue: Spidey's tingling warning of danger has this hyphenated nickname.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is spider-sense! Some fans call it the Peter tingle. [chuckles] Classic.

clues.clue: In the MCU, this LEGO-loving best friend discovers Peter's secret first.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Ned! [excited] The guy in the chair. Every hero needs one.

clues.clue: Spider-Man first swung onto the page in 1962 in issue 15 of this comic.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Amazing Fantasy! Number fifteen, created by Stan Lee and Steve Ditko.
